main_text.p: tis[?], Iof.10.9. Futur. ויזנב Et decandavit, id est, postremo agmine cæcidit, Deut.25.8.

זנה Scortatus est: Construitur cum Præpositionibus, אחרי, על, אל, מן, ב, את: לזנות אל בנות Infin. Scortari cum filiabus Moab, Num.25.1. ubi אל idem est quod עם. Futur. per Apocopam; ויזן Et scortata est; Jer.3.8. Pyh.Præt. זונה Scortatio peracta fuit, Ezech.16. v.34. Hiph.Præter. הוניר Scortaris, Hos.5.3. Infinit. הזנה הזנו Scortando scortati sunt, Hos.4.18. כהזנות Sicut scortata est, 2.Par.21.13. Et transitive, להזנותה Faciendo ut scortetur ipsa, Lev.19.29. Futur. per Apocopam, ויזן Et scortari fecit, 2.Par.21.11.

זוֹנָה f. Scortum, Meretrix: אשה זונה Mulierem meretricem, Levit.21.7. Sic etiam Græci Interpretes acceperunt Jos.2.v.1. reddentes ἡ πόρνη. Id imitati Apostoli, ad Hebraos11.31. Jac.2.25. Vide זן. Plural. נשים זונות Mulieres meretrices, 2.Reg.3.16. והזונות ex alia significatione; vide in זן.
זְנוּת f. Scortatio, Hos.4.11. Plural. formæ masculinæ cum Aff. זנותיכם Scortationes vestras, Num.14.33. בזנותיך In scortationibus tuis, Jer.3.2.
זֹנוּנִים m. p. Scortationes, Hos.1. v.2. Construct. זנוני 2. Regum 9.22. Aff. ותסר זנוניה Et auferat scortationes suas, Hos.2.2.
תִּזְנוּת f. Scortatio: Aff. תזנותם Scortationem suam, Ezech.23.8. Plural. formæ masc. cum Aff. תזנותיה Scortationes suas, Ezech.23.7.

זנח Deseruit, Abjecit, Rejecit, Repulit: Præter. נזנחה ישראל Deseruit Israel, Hos.8. v.3. Futur. לא יזנח Non rejicit, Thren.3.31. Hiph. Præter. אשר הזניח Quæ abjecerat, 2.Paral.29.19. Cum Epenthesi והאזניחו Et retrò abjecerunt, Jes.19.6. יזניחך Rejicient te; 2.Par.28.9[?].

page.notes: The first word of the top paragraph (ùs) is doubtful; read as "tis"[?], possibly "ut". The Hebrew forms are copied from the scan; several vowel points and letters are uncertain and were not all individually checked. The reference "1.Par." / "2.Par.28.9" at the end of the last entry is hard to read. A small asterisk at the foot of the last entry is not transcribed. The letter ע at the top is a printed dictionary section letter. Long s was read as plain s throughout (e.g. "Jes."). The catchword "זנונים" is the first word of the next entry.
